text_block_list.text:
It happened when the two of us went out.
When I asked Biko Pegasus if there was
anywhere she wanted to go—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, yes!! The Furlong Tower!!
In that case, the Furlong Tower would be awesome!!
choice_data_list: Is there something at the tower?
Is there something at the tower?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I watched a movie the other day!
It was about a hero who grows giant to fight monsters,
'Galaxy Menko'!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"A giant Galaxy is as tall as the Furlong Tower!
That's why I want to climb it~!!"
choice_data_list: Then, let's go experience a hero's perspective!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I did iiiiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!! So eeeeexpensiveeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The people and cars look like toys!
It's hard work trying not to step on them!

Biko Pegasus is totally in giant-hero mode.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh. Look at that, Biko's here too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai!
What a coincidence bumping into you here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan just got back from the movies! "Galaxy Menko" was so awesome~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!! Senpai, you watched it too?!
It was so cool, wasn't it~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Galaxy!!
—Great Monster Mezzula!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wait, why the monster!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It fell just a bit short in the movie, but the monster
was waaaay cooler, no contest!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I'm gonna turn into anything, I wanna be a monster!
I'll go on a giant rampage and cause trouble for everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat!?
A hero of justice would never let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-hehh~~! Just try and stop me if you can!

Moving to a spot that wouldn't be in the way,
the epic battle (pretend play) between the Giant Hero and the Great Kaiju began!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm the giant monster Windy-chan~!
I'm gonna munch on the train~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“—Hyaaah! I'm gonna protect the peace on Earth!
Pegasus Barrier!! Shiiing!!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
In that case, sticky mud attack!
I'll make it so you can't move~! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll wash that kind of thing away with my Pegasus Water Stream!
Zubababababa!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now! Return quietly to the sea,
Windy-senpai!
Or else I'll blast you with my Pegasus Ray!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... At Windy-chan's feet are humans who failed to escape!
If you shoot, you'll blow them to smithereens too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaaaaat—?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan's gonna run wild and rampage without a care! Gyaaaar! Crash and smash!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Kh! At this rate, I'm completely helpless...!
What am I supposed to do...!?
It was just make-believe, so Biko Pegasus hadn't actually grown giant, but she still desperately tried to protect the "humans" in the scenario.
choice_data_list: Join the defense squad and assist the hero!
I suggest a tactical retreat here.

text_block_list.text: I told Biko Pegasus to leave the evacuation of the stragglers to me, and to focus on fighting without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Agent Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes~~! Pegasus Death Ray!!
Bzzzzzzzz!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Gnnnngh~! The odds are against me today!
I'll let you off the hook for now!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yay!! Earth's peace has been protected!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "This win doesn't belong to just me! It's all thanks to Trainer working together with me!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Because a hero joins forces with everyone to protect the peace!
It was only make-believe, but Biko Pegasus remained true to her convictions as a hero nonetheless!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I can't turn a hero's techniques against ordinary citizens! As frustrating as it is, do I have no choice but to retreat...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It's a massive victory for Windy-chan!!
Time to let loose a triumphant roar~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai!? There are people that way—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is the strongest!! ROOOAAAR!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Windy!?
What do you think you're doing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmh, Hishi Ama was here too?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still, no one can stop the invincible monster Windy-chan!!
Roar! ROAAAARRRR!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you think you're doing, but you're bothering the other customers!
Hey, come over here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nga!? Let go, let me goooo~!
Graaaa~~ooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Are kaiju always fated to be defeated, no matter what they do?
Watching the giant monster get dragged away, Biko Pegasus muttered under her breath in disbelief.
